cv_sections.summary:
I am Mohammed Arslaan Thanedar, I have a strong interest
about the world of backend operations & architectures of software
applications. From automating processes to optimizing operations, I
am excited to learn and explore the technologies and practices that
keep applications running smoothly and efficiently.
As a Cloud and DevOps enthusiast, I am passionate about driving
digital transformation through the use of cloud technologies and
agile practices. With a strong foundation in both development and
operations, I am skilled in implementing end-to-end solutions that
optimize efficiency and scalability.
Throughout my graduation journey, I have gained a strong
foundation in cloud computing and a passion for driving digital
transformation through the use of cloud-based technologies.
As a part of my graduation journey I had the opportunity to mentor
students on cloud computing under GDSC Mentorship program.
Through this role, I was able to help others learn and grow both
personally and professionally, I have also learned the importance
of mentorship and the satisfaction that comes from helping others
achieve their goals.
Always seeking new opportunities to learn and grow as a Cloud and
DevOps professional, Whether it's automating processes, optimizing
infrastructure, or building and deploying applications, I am driven by
the challenge of finding innovative solutions to complex problems.
I am eager to connect with like-minded professionals and explore
new opportunities in the field.
Let's build the future together!
